title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms for Fake News Detection
description: University data-mining research software comparing multinomial Naive Bayes, logistic regression, linear SVM, random forest, entropy-based decision tree and a CNN with softmax. Includes original source code and a compatible data preparation script. Third-party datasets, model weights, coursework deliverables and student identifiers are excluded. This is a classification experiment, not a validated fact-checking service. Original software: all rights reserved.
